headline: Buy Boldly When Others Fear! "5 Peak-Season Dark Horse Stocks" Blaze Ahead, Ready for Q4 Main Uptrend | Finance
summary: The TAIEX closed up 122 points at 48,475 on Friday, October 2, a record high, with trading volume near NT$900 billion after a period of consolidation.
why: The TAIEX is Taiwan's benchmark index, dominated by large technology and semiconductor companies, so its moves signal broad domestic equity sentiment.

impacts.name: TAIEX
impacts.why: The benchmark index rose to a record close on strong trading volume.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The index broke through its high-level trading range and closed up 122 points on heavy volume, a record close according to the report.
